items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: they formed the Pelicans of Silvertone Orchestra... consisted of Walter Pichauds and Paul Barbaran and it was... Manuel Sayles guitar, banjo.

ctx.x: Yeah, the two rods and something.

Yeah, yeah, separated tumscrew rods. And then the later years, I went in from, let's see, it was 28, when I was working, John Robichauds, he had another dance orchestra. We used to play it, locally work around, you know, country club the same way, evening dances, night dances. It was like the Young Tuxedo Band. And during that year of, 20, later part of 1928, I was the, Paul Barbaran, when Lloyd Contrell died, the old drummer, he died, Paul Barbaran went into P-Round's band and he played a while him and his…
